body:
Yeah it's a balanced kit....for level 30... I have a few suggestions for buffs. 

Buff 1: 10 enderpearls, 3 second cooldown

or

Buff 2: enderpearls travel with 2x speed (possible)

or

Buff 3: projectile protection 3 iron helmet (ever tried shooting an Enderman?)
